bias.en: Neutral · pulling back after the October bounce

read.en: Applied Materials has slipped 6.5% from the Oct 5 close of $542 and now sits just below its 5, 10 and 100-day averages ($516–522). It remains above the 30-day ($474), 50-day ($490) and 200-day ($434). MACD is still above its signal line, but the histogram has shrunk for four days in a row, and RSI has cooled from 70 to 55.
read.zh: 应用材料自 10月5日收盘价 $542 回落 6.5%，现略低于 5 日、10 日与 100 日均线（$516–522），仍高于 30 日（$474）、50 日（$490）和 200 日（$434）均线。MACD 仍在信号线上方，但柱体已连续四日收缩，RSI 由 70 降至 55。

read.en: The first test is the 50-day near $490; holding it keeps the September rebound intact. Below that, $472–474 (the 30-day and a late-September shelf) and then $436, a low hit on Jul 29 and again on Sep 3. Overhead, $516–522 must be reclaimed first, then $542–548, which capped rallies in August and October.
read.zh: 首先测试约 $490 的 50 日均线；守住则 9月以来的反弹未破。跌破则看 $472–474（30 日均线及 9月下旬平台），再看 7月29日与 9月3日两度触及的低点 $436。上方需先收复 $516–522，然后是 8月与 10月两度压制反弹的 $542–548。

r.en: Capped rallies in Aug and Oct ($542–548)
